limitations: Capital pool detail had 2 of 182 requests over 3 s (max 17299 ms) in the 60 s two-caller run at 11:46:32Z. The capital owner access log shows its /api/bindings and /api/allocations responses stalled from 11:46:32.6Z to 11:46:42.9Z and 11:46:49.9Z while its readiness probe answered on schedule; Postgres logged nothing and no ranking snapshot was written then. 814 later requests never exceeded 600 ms. The cause is not identified and no task was opened.

Idle /bff/me samples taken right after login reached 1510 ms and 851 ms while the landing page loaded its reads; samples after the landing load stayed under 400 ms. The 500 ms criterion was measured during the target reads only.
Research orchestrator and trainer job counts (22 and 22) come from the BFF walk and were not counted independently from those owners; the source-ingest count was.
The degraded and failed list states were produced with browser-local stubs, not a real owner failure.
Ranking snapshots keep growing at one row of about 394 KB every 15.4 minutes (1489 rows). Reads no longer decode them; retention is waiting on the operator and no row was touched.
The job progress drawer still only hydrates on /management/evidence; it was out of scope by operator decision.
